title: execution_result
description: Schema for execution_result_NNNN.json artefacts mirroring claude --print --output-format json payload (Initiative_Orchestrator_Spec_v1_4 §5.2 + Phase 0 Test 6). Phase 4a P4-06. NOTE: additionalProperties is false per plan §13; real claude output containing fields not enumerated here will fail validation — surface as Phase Z phase4a_validator_stub_data_quality if encountered.

result.description: Final text output from the session.

total_cost_usd.description: Cumulative USD spend for the session.

permission_denials.description: Per-permission denial records. Non-empty array fails §10.5 FR-019 post-execution gate.

terminal_reason.description: Termination cause. §10.5 FR-019 requires `completed` to pass the post-execution gate.

duration_api_ms.description: Optional API-call cumulative duration in ms.

is_error.description: Optional error flag from claude CLI.
